boundaryRendering: Display one selected boundary type; no additional municipal context stroke. Selected scope is unfilled except meaning-specific population aggregate data.
municipalMask: Actual municipal polygon remains the transparent aperture; the outside context mask has opacity 0.78 and does not intercept input.
scope: Source ID determines aggregate/list membership independently of viewport. Intersecting records may belong to more than one source boundary; subtotals are not additive.
datasetChange: Retain scope and camera for ordinary dataset changes. A boundary dataset chooses its matching boundary view and resets incompatible scope.
boundaryViewChange: Reset to municipal scope, clear record/search/page and fit the municipal area.
recordSelection: Open one record separately; retain scope aggregates. Fit only when the explicit focus-record control is used.
navigation: Map polygons and list rows select the same source scope ID. Enter/Space activates a focused boundary; breadcrumb/back returns to the available parent.
camera: Fit on explicit area drill/back/fit/record-focus; ordinary dataset, theme and language changes retain camera.
url: Validated dataset, boundary, scope, lang, theme and optional record ID restore state across reload; browser back/forward supported.
missingEvidence: Missing geometry, unknown CRS, no-data population or current flood metrics remain unavailable with explanations; never infer administrative parentage, tax ownership or flood risk from display geometry.
